dict.string: SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items in a folder you choose (such as Desktop) to draw a space map. It does not read regular file contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data.

SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items in a folder you choose (such as Documents) to draw a space map. It does not read document contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data.

SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items in a folder you choose (such as Downloads) to draw a space map. It does not read regular file contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data.

SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items on a network volume you choose to draw a space map. It does not read regular file contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data.

SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items on a removable volume you choose to draw a space map. It does not read regular file contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data.
